arguments.value: This agreement is a natural gas transportation contract dated May 20, 1992, between Arkansas Western Pipeline Company, the transporter, and Associated Natural Gas Company, a division of Arkansas Western Gas Company, the shipper. Arkansas Western Pipeline Company agrees to transport gas for Associated Natural Gas Company under the pipeline’s FTS/ITS tariff, with a maximum daily quantity of 23,000 Dth, using the receipt and delivery points listed in the exhibits. Associated Natural Gas Company must tender gas at the receipt points, and Arkansas Western Pipeline Company must redeliver an equivalent amount minus fuel use and shrinkage at the delivery points. The agreement runs for a 10-year primary term and then continues month to month until ended by notice, with charges determined by the applicable tariff and subject to regulatory changes. It also says that if firm capacity is reduced, Associated Natural Gas Company’s service is reduced proportionally with other firm shippers, and that the agreement is governed by Arkansas law and replaces prior transportation agreements between the parties. The source also includes later release and assignment documents showing that Associated Natural Gas Company permanently released 13,370 MMBtu per day of firm capacity to United Cities Gas Company, a division of Atmos Energy Corporation, under the same transportation arrangement.
